Once completed, please proceed with the next step 4.7.3: 8.3.3.4.3 Submit for Approval and notify GFR where required.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Submit for Approval and notify GFR where required
steps.detail:
Business will share the list of assets to be impaired with Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office for review and request for necessary approval. The outcome of an impairment review may be a request to impair the asset for group of assets value (Value Based) or to change the asset’s useful economic life (Time-based). Please refer to step 4.7.13: 8.3.3.4.13 Impair Asset by Updating asset Useful Life for time-based impairment.

With reference to Section 4.4.4 AZ Global Capital and Fixed Assets Standard (Refer Section 7 References for link), value-based impairment should be approved under the appropriate DOA. Impairment charge should be assessed against activity code ‘2003 - CAPITAL EXPENDITURE & DISPOSAL’.

Any impairment greater than $5m should be communicated to GFR. Impairments with unusual, complex or judgemental issues, and / or greater than $10m, will require a formal Accounting Issues Note to be submitted to GFR.

Determine DOA approver

Use this link to navigate to the global DOA to determine the approver for impairment: http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DOAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_adf.ctrl-state=147ow55mve_4

Click on “search”:

Click on the “Country” drop-down in the Search bar for the relevant requester’s country. Next, select the activity code “2003 - CAPITAL EXPENDITURE & DISPOSAL” and click on ‘search”.

A list of approvers will then appear as the screenshot below:

Select the appropriate level of approver based on the value of impairment. Note: any approver with authorisation equal to or greater than the impairment value can be requested for DOA approval.

Submit request for approval

Send request via email to the required DOA approver, with the fixed Assets Impairment Template attached including the fixed assets subject to impairment. Please note that GFR will also need to be notified for assets greater than $5 million threshold.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Review and provide approval to asset impairment request
steps.detail:
Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will review the asset impairment request shared by the Business via Email and will determine if the template reflects the correct information from the asset register.

Note: Please ensure you perform control CPX013 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.

UK and Sweden Hubs to continue with operating the CPX010 instead of CPX013.

Review impairment request

At the time of review, check that the accounting treatment is in line with the Group Accounting Manual (Section D1) and the Global Capital standard. Please refer Section 7 References for link to the Group Accounting Manual.

Verify Net Book Value (NBV)

Please note that checking the NBV is relevant to all types of impairment.

Go to T-code AW01N:

Note: We can also use SAP T-code “S_ALR_87011963” to check balance for multiple assets, acquisition date, Asset Class, NBV. Refer sub step 4.7.2 8.3.3.4.2 A.2) Display Data for Multiple Assets

Open the template and view the asset details:

Enter Company code, Asset number and Asset subnumber (where applicable) as per the template and press “Enter”:

Asset number

Company code

This will open the asset in Asset Explorer:

Click on the “Posted values” tab to view Net Book Value. Please ensure that the depreciation area 01 is selected and the fiscal year is the year for the posting date.

Fiscal year

Depreciation area 01

Current NBV

Check that the asset NBV at the time of the impairment posting date matches the Net Book Value on the form. In this case the impairment posting is in February. Since depreciation is posted till January, the current NBV will be the NBV at the impairment posting date.

If the impairment posting date is in a subsequent month, instead, the current NBV must be reduced by the total amount of planned depreciation up to period preceding impairment posting date. Check that this value is the same as the Net Book Value mentioned in the form.

Verify asset useful life

Note: In case the request is for updating useful life of asset, then an additional check is required to ensure that the current useful life is correct as per SAP. Refer to the Asset Master Data Maintenance Template as given below:

For useful life information, run T-code AS03 to display the asset:

Enter the company code, asset number and subnumber (where applicable) from the template, and press enter.

Check that this matches with the template values

These details will be verified from the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template.

Approve impairment request

Once the asset impairment request template is reviewed, if the accounting treatment is not in line with the Group Accounting Manual (Section D) and the Global Capital Standard, or, if the template is not in line with the SAP asset register data, then Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will advise the business to proceed with Step 4.7.5: 8.3.3.4.5 Amend Request.

If approval is granted, proceed with Step 4.7.6: 8.3.3.4.6 Raise Asset Impairment Request.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Amend Request
steps.detail:
If the request has been rejected by Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, the Business will be informed of the rejection via email, including the reason for rejection. The Business will need to amend the request submitted, based on feedback received from the Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, and repeat the process starting from Step 4.7.3: 8.3.3.4.3 Submit for approval and notify GFR where required.

Amend Fixed Asset impairment request based on feedback from Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office

Based on feedback / instructions received from Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, perform the necessary changes to the fixed asset impairment request template and / or asset report

containing the listing of assets which require impairment. Once completed, proceed to Step 4.7.3: 8.3.3.4.3 Submit for approval and notify GFR where required.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Raise Asset Impairment request
steps.detail:
On obtaining the approval from Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, the Business will raise the request for the fixed asset impairment and submit to GFS Back Office R2R for processing.

If impairment needs to be processed for a large volume of assets at a time, this would be considered a strategic impairment request and the feasibility of processing this before Month-end would need to be checked by GFS Back Office R2R. Please see step 4.7.7 8.3.3.4.7 Submit major strategic impairment request.

In case of a regular impairment, depending on the type of impairment as per the template produced in step 4.7.2 8.3.3.4.2 Prepare list of assets for impairment with accounting treatment, proceed with the impairment request.

Analyse if the request is value-based impairment or time-based impairment.

In case of value related impairments, proceed to step 4.7.12: 8.3.3.4.12 Impair Asset using unplanned depreciation. In case of time related impairments, proceed to step 4.7.13: 8.3.3.4.13 Review financial impact and provide approval for useful life update.

If the request is a major strategic adjustment, the Business will submit a request via email to GFS Back Office R2R to review and determine the feasibility of completion by Month-end close.

TASK NAME

steps.title: Review request and determine feasibility to complete by month end close
steps.detail:
GFS Back Office R2R receives a request for major strategic impairment via email from the business. GFS Back Office R2R reviews the impairment request and determines feasibility to complete the request in sub-ledger by month end close.

Receive and review major strategic impairment request

Once the request has been received, perform a review on the request to determine if the impairment can be accommodated and completed by month end close. The assessment will be undertaken by the GFS Back Office R2R team lead responsible for fixed assets. Assessment is on a case-by-case basis and will consider the volume of fixed assets to be impaired.

If the volume of impairment is feasible to process before month end, GFS Back Office R2R will proceed with the impairment request in sub-ledger.

In addition, if the depreciation for the month is already posted, then the unplanned depreciation can only be posted in the next period. For the current period, a manual journal entry needs to be posted and reversed in subsequent month.

If the request can be fulfilled before the month end, proceed to Step 4.7.12: 8.3.3.4.12 Impair Asset using unplanned depreciation.

If the request cannot be fulfilled before month end, notify Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office via email to proceed to Step 4.7.9: 8.3.3.4.9 Submit request to post one-time Financial Accounting Journal.

steps.detail:
CFO / Controller will be notified of the impairment journal entry request that was routed for approval. CFO / Controller will then review the request and confirm feasibility of completing the request by Month end close, based on response from GFS Back Office R2R.

steps.detail:
Unplanned depreciation will have the effect of increasing the depreciation so that the NBV will reflect the recoverable amount. Subsequent month’s depreciation will be posted as per the planned depreciation schedule.

GFS Back Office R2R will receive an impairment request and will review it before further processing. If the request is to update useful life, this will be redirected to GFS Back Office DMT, once the request is reviewed and found to be correct. If the request is to perform impairment through unplanned depreciation, this will be taken forward by GFS Back Office R2R.

Fixed assets can be retired either by transfer (within a legal entity or between legal entities), or through a system-based retirement (with or without an invoice). To initiate the asset retirement process, upon request from the Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will complete the Assets Retirement Request Template and obtain approval from the appropriate approver as per the Global Delegation of Authority (DOA). Once approved, the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template will either be routed to GFS Back Office DMT for transfers within the same legal entities, or Assets Retirement Request Template and Assets Transfer Request Template to GFS Back Office R2R for all other types of retirement. GFS Back Office DMT and GFS Back Office R2R will access the template for details with regard to the retirement. GFS Back Office R2R will then perform validation of the request details and check the supporting documents against DOA and SAP. Examples of items to check are the approver, the cost centre and the net book value of the asset. Once the process is completed, GFS Back Office DMT and GFS Back Office R2R will inform the Business via Email. # AUDIENCE This SOP applies to Embedded Finance, GFS Middle Office, GFS Back Office R2R and GFS Back Office DMT. # SCOPE The table below contains a summary of the Systems, Regions, Countries and Business Areas that this document relates to. 8.3.3.10.1

Request for asset retirement
Responsible Accountable Consulted Informed
Business Business N/A Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office

The process for fixed asset retirement begins when there is a need to decommission / sell / transfer / retire a fixed asset. The Business sends a request via email for asset retirement or transfer and attaches relevant supporting documents required to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office. The request should include the following information:

  • Company code

  • Fixed Asset Number

  • Type of Retirement

  • Asset Retirement Effective Date

  • New cost centre (in case of a transfer within a legal entity)

Sample email request for asset retirement:
Task # TASK NAME
8.3.3.10.2

Complete Asset Retirement form
Responsible Accountable Consulted Informed
Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office Business N/A

Once the Business has requested an asset retirement, prepare the Asset Retirement Request Template or Assets Master Data Maintenance template (in case of a transfer within a legal entity) and the supporting documents.

  1. Create request for asset retirement

There are different requests for different types of retirement:

A.1) For transfer within legal entity (without asset class change)

For a fixed asset transfer within a legal entity (without a change in asset class), change the cost centre in the fixed asset master data.

The Assets Master Data Maintenance template needs to be filled with the recipient cost centre with the help of the Business requester when necessary. Maintenance Type should be: “CHANGE”

DOA approval for an Asset Master Record Change is not required. Once the Assets Master Data Maintenance template is complete, proceed to sub-step 8.3.3.10.3 4.7.3 B) Create an Email request for an asset retirement and send the completed template for approval to the team lead. A sample email request is shown below:

A sample email approval is shown below:

Once the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template is approved, proceed to the step 8.3.3.10.3 4.7.3 Submit or amend request to transfer, decommission or sell asset. Obtain approvals as per DOA to transfer the asset within a legal entity by changing the asset master record.

A.2) For transfer within legal entity (with asset class change)

For a fixed asset transfer within a legal entity with asset class change, the asset's net book value needs to be transferred to a new asset. The Assets Transfer Request Template needs to be filled in with the mandatory fields (highlighted in Red).

If the Receiver Asset Numbers have already been created upon raising a request for asset transfer, please select “Yes” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field. Column L until Column AS will be blacked out as this information is only required for asset creation (where applicable).

There are other mandatory fields in order to create Asset Number in different SAP Instances.

UK – Cost Center/ Evaluation Group 2 (Set Area)/ Evaluation Group 5 (Location) and Depreciation start date

Sweden – Cost Center/ Depreciation start date

NAM – Cost Center/ Responsible Cost Center/ Evaluation Group 1 (State)/ Evaluation Group 2 (Location)/ Evaluation Group 3 (Type of Asset Class)/ Depreciation start date

If the Receiver Asset Numbers need to be created upon request for asset transfer, please select “No” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field.

DOA approval for an Asset Class change is not required. Once the Assets Transfer Request Template is complete, proceed to sub-step: 8.3.3.10.3 4.7.3 B) Create an Email request for an asset retirement for an asset retirement to transfer the asset within a legal entity with asset class change.

A.3) For transfer to other legal entities, non-invoice retirements or invoice retirements

For a transfer to another legal entity, raise a request to retire the asset in the transferring legal entity. After the asset is retired, invoice it to the receiving entity through an inter-company Non-Trade Invoice (NTI). Please refer to process 8.3.2.12 Post Inter-company Non-Trade Transactions for this. Add the asset in the Purchasing Entity through the process 8.3.3.3 Process & Record Fixed Asset Additions.

First, the transferring legal entity needs to complete the Assets Retirement Request Template, including the Net Book Value (NBV) of the retiring asset.

  1. Check the NBV of assets

The SAP report can be generated by executing T-code “AS03” to open single asset balance and T-code “S_ALR_87011963” to review multiple open asset balances information.

B.1) To check Single Asset Balance

Login to SAP following the instructions as shown below:

Enter SAP T-code AS03.

Insert the asset number, the sub number (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template, press Enter.

The below screen appears displaying the Asset Master Data. Verify on below data with the Assets Retirement Request Template.

  1. Asset number

  2. Asset description

  3. Asset Capitalization Date

Then, click on “Asset Values” and verify the asset’s NBV.

Then, go to the “Posted Values” tab. Compare the NBV there with the NBV in the template and ensure that both the values are same.

B.2) To check balance for Multiple Assets

Enter SAP T-code “S_ALR_87011963”.

Fill in the parameters as mentioned below:

  • Company code - As per the request

  • Input asset numbers by selecting and input asset number as per template

  • Report date – input the last month end date of the last depreciation run.

  • Depreciation area – input a value of “01” which indicates for book depreciation

  • Sort variant - 0001

  • Select List assets

Click on the “Execute” button or press “F8” to proceed.

Look for the asset number(s) from the request in the column “Asset” to identify the NBV in column “Book val.”

Using the information above, verify on below data with the Assets Retirement Request Template.

  1. Asset number

  2. Asset description

  3. Asset Capitalization Date

  4. Asset Acquisition Value

Once all evidence is gathered, the template needs to be authorized by the delegated DOA. Assets Retirement approver must have 2003 DOA Authority (Capital Expenditure and Asset Disposal). Please check DOA Portal through this link. Refer sub-step 8.3.3.10.6 4.7.6 C) Verify approver against Global DOA.

GFS Back Office R2R will be notified once the sale of asset has been completed and will then account for the profit & loss on the disposal of the asset. Sales proceeds must be entered into an asset disposal transaction. The purchase and sale of fixed assets is executed at fair market valuation.

Create and transmit customer invoice

Embedded Finance will be notified once the sale of asset has been completed and the profit & loss on the disposal of the asset has been posted. If GFS Middle Office submitted the request on behalf of Embedded Finance, then GFS Middle Office needs to be notified once the sale of asset has been completed. Upon request, if a customer invoice is needed, GFS Back Office R2R will create a customer invoice and email to their Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office directly.

  1. Create Customer Invoice

To print a customer invoice, please go to t-code FB03

Enter the asset sales Document Number, Company Code and Fiscal Year, then press “Enter”.

At next screen, click on “Environment” at menu bar and select “Correspondence”.

A list of correspondence type will be displayed as below. Select the relevant correspondence type which is applicable for the respective countries. (for AU10 its SAP19).

Next screen will indicate “Customer Invoice was requested”

Next go to t-code F.64

Enter the correspondence type and company code, then click execute the program.

Double click on the document you have selected for correspondence request.

At the output parameters enter Output device and select “Continue”

At the invoice preview, select the “Back” icon

An email in window will pop up, input your email address and click “yes” in order to receive the invoice in PDF format

An email will be triggered and send to your mailbox with invoice in PDF format. Save a copy and share the invoice with requestor.

Note: In order to trigger an email to send the PDF invoice, Customer master data “Clark’s Internet” field must maintained with an email address. If the customer master data that you need to print invoice does not have this field maintained, please send a request to Back Office DMT team to maintain this field.

steps.title: Request for asset retirement
steps.detail:
The process for fixed asset retirement begins when there is a need to decommission / sell / transfer / retire a fixed asset. The Business sends a request via email for asset retirement or transfer and attaches relevant supporting documents required to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office. The request should include the following information:

Company code

Fixed Asset Number

Type of Retirement

Asset Retirement Effective Date

New cost centre (in case of a transfer within a legal entity)

Sample email request for asset retirement:

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Complete Asset Retirement form
steps.detail:
Once the Business has requested an asset retirement, prepare the Asset Retirement Request Template or Assets Master Data Maintenance template (in case of a transfer within a legal entity) and the supporting documents.

Create request for asset retirement

There are different requests for different types of retirement:

A.1) For transfer within legal entity (without asset class change)

For a fixed asset transfer within a legal entity (without a change in asset class), change the cost centre in the fixed asset master data.

The Assets Master Data Maintenance template needs to be filled with the recipient cost centre with the help of the Business requester when necessary. Maintenance Type should be: “CHANGE”

DOA approval for an Asset Master Record Change is not required. Once the Assets Master Data Maintenance template is complete, proceed to sub-step 8.3.3.10.3 4.7.3 B) Create an Email request for an asset retirement and send the completed template for approval to the team lead. A sample email request is shown below:

A sample email approval is shown below:

Once the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template is approved, proceed to the step 8.3.3.10.3 4.7.3 Submit or amend request to transfer, decommission or sell asset. Obtain approvals as per DOA to transfer the asset within a legal entity by changing the asset master record.

A.2) For transfer within legal entity (with asset class change)

For a fixed asset transfer within a legal entity with asset class change, the asset's net book value needs to be transferred to a new asset. The Assets Transfer Request Template needs to be filled in with the mandatory fields (highlighted in Red).

If the Receiver Asset Numbers have already been created upon raising a request for asset transfer, please select “Yes” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field. Column L until Column AS will be blacked out as this information is only required for asset creation (where applicable).

There are other mandatory fields in order to create Asset Number in different SAP Instances.

UK - Cost Center/ Evaluation Group 2 (Set Area)/ Evaluation Group 5 (Location) and Depreciation start date

Sweden - Cost Center/ Depreciation start date

NAM - Cost Center/ Responsible Cost Center/ Evaluation Group 1 (State)/ Evaluation Group 2 (Location)/ Evaluation Group 3 (Type of Asset Class)/ Depreciation start date

If the Receiver Asset Numbers need to be created upon request for asset transfer, please select “No” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field.

DOA approval for an Asset Class change is not required. Once the Assets Transfer Request Template is complete, proceed to sub-step: 8.3.3.10.3 4.7.3 B) Create an Email request for an asset retirement for an asset retirement to transfer the asset within a legal entity with asset class change.

A.3) For transfer to other legal entities, non-invoice retirements or invoice retirements

For a transfer to another legal entity, raise a request to retire the asset in the transferring legal entity. After the asset is retired, invoice it to the receiving entity through an inter-company Non-Trade Invoice (NTI). Please refer to process 8.3.2.12 Post Inter-company Non-Trade Transactions for this. Add the asset in the Purchasing Entity through the process 8.3.3.3 Process & Record Fixed Asset Additions.

First, the transferring legal entity needs to complete the Assets Retirement Request Template, including the Net Book Value (NBV) of the retiring asset.

Check the NBV of assets

The SAP report can be generated by executing T-code “AS03” to open single asset balance and T-code “S_ALR_87011963” to review multiple open asset balances information.

B.1) To check Single Asset Balance

Login to SAP following the instructions as shown below:

Enter SAP T-code AS03.

Insert the asset number, the sub number (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template, press Enter.

The below screen appears displaying the Asset Master Data. Verify on below data with the Assets Retirement Request Template.

Asset number

Asset description

Asset Capitalization Date

Then, click on “Asset Values” and verify the asset’s NBV.

Then, go to the “Posted Values” tab. Compare the NBV there with the NBV in the template and ensure that both the values are same.

B.2) To check balance for Multiple Assets

Enter SAP T-code “S_ALR_87011963”.

Fill in the parameters as mentioned below:

Company code - As per the request

Input asset numbers by selecting  and input asset number as per template

Report date - input the last month end date of the last depreciation run.

Depreciation area - input a value of “01” which indicates for book depreciation

Sort variant - 0001

Select List assets

Click on the “Execute” button  or press “F8” to proceed.

Look for the asset number(s) from the request in the column “Asset” to identify the NBV in column “Book val.”

Using the information above, verify on below data with the Assets Retirement Request Template.

Asset number

Asset description

Asset Capitalization Date

Asset Acquisition Value

Once all evidence is gathered, the template needs to be authorized by the delegated DOA. Assets Retirement approver must have 2003 DOA Authority (Capital Expenditure and Asset Disposal). Please check DOA Portal through this link. Refer sub-step 8.3.3.10.6 4.7.6 C) Verify approver against Global DOA.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Submit or amend request to transfer, decommission or sell asset. Obtain approvals as per DOA
steps.detail:
Before an asset retirement can take place, the requester must submit the template with supporting documents to the appropriate approver according to DOA.

Request for approval for asset retirement

Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office requests the review and approval as per Delegations Standard Limits from Global DOA framework. A sample email approval request is shown below:

If the templates have not been completed / filled in correctly:

If amendment is required, amend the template accordingly and proceed to the step: 8.3.3.10.3: 4.7.3 Submit or amend request to transfer, decommission or sell asset. Obtain approvals as per DOA.

When there is no need for asset retirement any more, terminate the request and the process ends.

If approved, an email approval will be sent by the respective approver, as per DOA 2003, as illustrated below.

Create an Email request for an asset retirement

Once the approval is obtained send an Email request for the asset retirement to

GFS Back Office DMT team to process the transfer within legal entity request. A sample request for an asset retirement as per the screenshot below:

GFS Back Office R2R FA team to process the other retirement types request. A sample request for an asset retirement as per the screenshot below:

There are different types of asset retirements as below:

Requests that need to be sent to GFS Back Office DMT

Asset Transfer within legal entity (which is not an update of asset class) - proceed to step 8.3.3.10.4: 4.7.4 Update fixed asset master data.

Requests that need to be sent to GFS Back Office R2R

Asset Transfer within legal entity (which is an update of asset class) - proceed to step 8.3.3.10.5: 4.7.5 Transfer the asset within legal entity

Asset Transfer between legal entities - proceed to step 8.3.3.10.6: 4.7.6 Execute transactions to retire asset

Retirement without invoice - proceed to step 8.3.3.10.7: 4.7.7 Retire partial or entire asset from FA Register

Retirement with invoice - proceed to step 8.3.3.10.8: 4.7.8 Retire entire asset for an invoice sale.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Update fixed asset master data
steps.detail:
If the transfer will be within the same legal entity (which is not an update of asset class), GFS Back Office DMT will perform an asset master data amendment (e.g. cost centre change).

Retrieve template from Email request

GFS Back Office DMT will access the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template from the Email request:

Open Assets Master Data Maintenance template

Open the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template and ensure all mandatory fields for the change request (marked with “*”, red, blue and green font colour as per “Instructions” tab in the request template) are complete in the Assets Master Data Maintenance template:

Update Cost Centre in SAP

Log into SAP and select the appropriate SAP instance. Next, enter the user PRID and password to login:

Next, to change asset master data enter SAP T-code “AS02” and press “Enter”:

Input the “Asset” number, the “Subnumber” (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance template . Press “Enter” to continue:

Change the “Cost Center” field in SAP to reflect the cost centre field in the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template. Save the change once done.

Close the asset retirement request

Once the asset master record is changed, save the Asset template by clicking “Save as”:

The shared folder as per following example: YYYY\Operation\Country code\2. Maintain Asset Master data\MM. MMMM\Change (e.g. 2015\Operation\PH\2. Maintain Asset Master Data\08. August\Change)

The file name as per the following mask: Request date_R2R-Asset number - Asset Change (e.g.: 06.08.2015_R2R115300000079 - Asset Change)

Send the completed request for approval to the team lead. A sample email approval request is shown below:

The GFS Back Office DMT Team Lead will check the asset master data maintenance has been performed by GFS Back Office DMT. This is to ensure that the data maintenance is complete and accurate by the end of the day. A sample email approval is shown below:

After that, send a confirmation to the requester on successful Asset Master Record change request completion. A sample email confirmation is shown below:

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Transfer the asset within legal entity
steps.detail:
If the transfer will be within the same legal entity (which is an update of asset class), GFS Back Office R2R will perform the asset transfer request as per the Asset Transfer Request Template.

Retrieve template from Email request

GFS Back Office R2R FA team will access the Assets Transfer Request Template from the Email request:

Open the Assets Transfer Request Template

Open the Assets Transfer Request Template and ensure all mandatory fields for the change request are complete in the template.

If the requestor selects “Yes” from the dropdown list in the “Receiver Asset Number Available?” field.

If the Receiver Asset Numbers need to be created upon request for asset transfer, please select “No” from the dropdown list in the “Receiver Asset Number Available?” field.

C) Validate information in the Assets Transfer Request Template

Log into SAP system to verify that data in the Assets Transfer Request Template is complete and accurate.

Next, to display the asset master data of sender data, execute SAP T-code AS03 and press “Enter”.

Insert the asset number, the Subnumber (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Transfer Request Template's sender data, and then press Enter.

Next, verify that the Asset Class and Asset’s Description match with the details in the template.

Then, click on “Asset Values” and verify the asset’s NBV.

Then, go to the “Posted Values” tab. Compare the NBV there with the NBV in the template and ensure that both the values are same.

In case of any discrepancy, send a query to the requester as per the below steps:

If the template received with requestor selecting “Yes” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field, please proceed to sub-step D) Perform transfer in system.

If the template received with requestor selecting “No” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field, email the template to GFS Back Office DMT to request for Receiver Asset Number creations before they can perform asset transfer process.

GFS Back Office DMT will email back the revised template once they have created the Receiver Asset Numbers.

GFS Back Office DMT will input the created Receiver Asset Number here

D) Perform transfer in system

Once all information has been verified, proceed to transfer the asset via SAP T-code ABUMN and press “Enter”:

Input details to transfer asset.

Input the following fields and press “Enter” to complete:

"Asset" - input the Sender data's asset number and sub-number (if provided)

“Document Date”, “Posting Date” and "Asset Value Date" - input the current date

“Text” - Company code and "Asset Retirement" text

“Existing Asset” - Select this option and input the Receiving Asset Number and sub-number (if applicable)

If there are other fields input to create the Receiver data's asset other than "Description", "Asset Class" and "Cost Center", click on "Master Data" for more fields to input.

If not, proceed to the next "Additional Details" tab.

In the “Additional Details” tab, key in the following.

“Posting Period” - input the month, in numeric value, e.g. “5”

“Document Type” - input the type “AA”

If requestor only wants to perform partial transfer, go to Partial Transfer tab in SAP to input the partial amount to be transferred.

Please note that for performing a partial transfer, there can be two scenarios as given below:

Asset transfer to more than one asset: If the request specifies the transfer to more than one asset, then the total amount would be split accordingly. For e.g. The above asset with total value as 987.50 can be transferred to one asset with value 300 and another asset with value 687.5

Partial transfer: If the request specifies the asset to be transferred partially, then the Amount Posted field should reflect the partial amount only. For e.g. Only 300 out of 987.50 to be transferred to the correct asset class (also shown in the screenshot below)

Post asset transfer

Once done, click on Save.

If the asset transfer has been posted successfully, a notification will appear to inform the posting document and newly created asset.

Verify that asset transfer is being posted

Check if the asset transfer is posted successfully in the system by going back to SAP T-code AS03 to display the Sender data asset master data. If successful, the Sender data asset will be updated with a Deactivation Date.

As for Asset Values, the NBV will now be blank to show that the asset no longer has any value. There will also be a new transaction below showing the retirement.

Note that after transferring the full NBV over to the receiving asset, the sender asset will be automatically deactivated.

To display the document details access SAP with the T-code FB03. Then key in the following fields and press “Enter”:

“Document Number” - input the posting document number

“Company Code” - input the relevant company code

“Fiscal Year” - input the current year

If the transfer posting exists, the data entry view for that document will open as pictured below:

To display the Receiver data asset master data access SAP with the T-code AS03. Then key in the following fields and press “Enter”.

“Document Number” - input the posting document number

“Company Code” - input the relevant company code

“Fiscal Year” - input the current year

Click on “Asset Values” to check NBV.

Notify the requester on request completion

Send email to inform the requester about the successful asset transfer transaction.

Below is the sample email:

Proceed to the step 8.3.3.10.10: 4.7.10 Receive confirmation that asset has been retired.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Execute transactions to retire asset
steps.detail:
If the transfer is between legal entities, GFS Back Office R2R will execute the transaction to retire the asset in the transferring entity. For regulatory requirements, the financial transfer must be processed at the time the physical transfer occurs.

This step is to transfer asset between legal entities in AZ, so we need to follow the NTI process:

From selling entity perspective, two steps are needed:

Issue an NTI to receiving party (Refer process 8.3.2.12 Post Intercompany Non-Trade Transactions for details)

Retire the assets

The asset of selling party will be retired from the FA register to gain / loss account. Then the respective GFS Back Office C2C or GFS Back Office P2P will post to the relevant customer / vendor account during NTI posting. Also note that the gain/loss account is auto-populated by the system.

From receiving entity perspective,

Post the NTI in a project

Capitalise the assets via process 8.3.3.3 Process and Record Fixed Asset Additions

Please ensure that you perform control CPX008 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.

Retrieve template from Email request

The GFS Back Office R2R FA team will access the Assets Retirement Request Template from the Email request:

Open Assets Retirement Request Template

Open the Assets Retirement Request Template and ensure all mandatory fields for the request (marked with “*”, and red font colour as per “Instructions” tab in the request Template) are complete.

The Assets Retirement Request Template is pictured below:

(same as example given in 8.3.3.10.2 4.7.2 C) For transfer to other legal entities, non-invoice retirements or invoice retirements)

Verify approver against Global DOA

Verify that there is email approval by the respective approver, as per DOA 2003, for the retirement of asset as illustrated below:

Ensure that the retirement is approved by the appropriate DOA. Please access Global DOA by using this link.

Click on the “Country” drop-down in the Search bar for the relevant requester’s country. Next, select the activity code “2003 - CAPITAL EXPENDITURE & DISPOSAL” and click on “Search”.

A list of approvers will then appear as the screenshot below. From the list, verify the name of the expected approver against the above approver’s email screenshot. In addition, also verify that the Asset’s amount is with the approver’s authority.

If the approval is not given by the appropriate approver / invalid approval, query back to the requester. A sample email query is shown below:

Validate information in the Assets Retirement Request Template

Log into SAP system to verify that data in the Assets Retirement Request Template is complete and accurate.

Use SAP T-code “AS03” to display Asset master data for single Asset and T-code “S_ALR_87011963” for displaying master data for multiple assets.

D.1) Display Single Asset Master Data

To display the asset master data, execute SAP T-code AS03 and press “Enter”:

Insert the asset number, the sub number (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance, press Enter.

The below screen appears displaying the Asset details: -

Under the tab “General” and in the “Capitalized on” field, the Capitalized Date can be found.

Ensure that asset has not already been retired by making sure that the “Deactivated on” field has been left blank.

Verify the asset cost centre by clicking on the “Time-dependent” tab.

Then, click on “Asset Values” and verify the Asset’s NBV:

Then, go to the “Posted Values” tab. Compare the NBV there with the NBV in the template and ensure that both values are the same:

D.2) Display Master Data for Multiple Assets

Enter SAP T-code “S_ALR_87011963”.

Fill in the parameters including:

Input asset numbers by selecting  and input asset number as per template

Report date - input the last month end date of the last depreciation run

Depreciation area - input a value of “01” which indicates for book depreciation

Sort variant - 0001

Select List assets

Click on the “Execute” button or press “F8” to proceed.

Look for the asset number(s) from the request in the column “Asset” to identify the NBV in column “Book val.”

Click on the requisite asset / assets to view the asset details. Choose the asset and double click on the Asset number to view details.

Next, verify that the Asset Class and Asset’s Description match the details in the template.

In case of any discrepancy, send a query to the requester. Sample email is shown below:

Send retirement request for approval

Send the request for approval to the GFS Back Office R2R FA Team Lead. A sample email approval request as below:

The GFS Back Office R2R FA Team Lead will ensure the asset retirement request has been checked by GFS Back Office R2R FA Team. This is to ensure that the transaction is complete and accurate. A sample email approval is shown below:

Retire asset in system

Once all the necessary information has been verified, proceed to retire the asset via SAP T-code ABAVN:

F.1) Enter company code in system

SAP automatically populates the Company Code. If it is incorrect, click on the “Change company code” button  to change it in the pop-up window.

It is important to ensure that the Company Code is correct as the system allows the same asset number to be created under different company codes.

F.2) Key in Asset number

For single asset retirement, key in the Asset number into the “Asset” field:

For multiple asset retirements, click on “Multiple Assets”. Note: This step is to be performed only in case of multiple asset retirements and below screenshot details does not match with template given above. If there are no multiple asset retirements, please move on to F.3) Key in details relating to Asset Date.

There will be a place under the “List of Assets” section for the user to fill in the list of assets to be retired. After keying in the list of assets, press Enter. The assets’ descriptions will automatically populate into the table.

Only six assets can be keyed in at a time. After the first six assets’ descriptions have been auto-populated (by pressing Enter), scroll down to key in the next six asset numbers, if any.

F.3) Key in details relating to Asset Date

In the “Transaction Data” tab, key in the following:

“Document Date” - input the date when the item is processed

“Posting Date” - input the date when the item is processed

“Asset Value Date” - input the Asset Retirement Effective Date as per the workitem

“Text” - input “Asset Retirement”.

F.4) Fill in additional details

In the “Additional Details” tab, key in the following:

“Posting Period” - input the month, in numeric value, e.g. “5”

“Document Type” - input the type “AA”

“Reference” - input “company code and the date of the request”

F.5) Simulate the posting

Next, click on the Simulate button :

After clicking on Simulate, a list of double entries will appear. Review the GL account and the amount to ensure that the simulated posting is correct:

F.6) Successful posting of the asset retirement

Once posted, a notification will be shown at the bottom of the screen, e.g. “Asset transaction posted with document no. CN20 0100007120”. This indicates that the asset has been successfully retired.

Verify that asset retirement is being posted

Check if the asset is posted successfully in the system by going back to SAP T-code AS03 to display the asset master data. If successful, the asset will be updated with a Deactivation Date:

As for Asset Values, the NBV will now be blank to show that the asset no longer has any value. There will also be a new transaction below showing the retirement.

To display the document details, access the SAP with the T-code FB03. Then key in the following fields and press “Enter”:

Document Number - input the posting document number

Company Code - input the relevant company code

Fiscal Year - input the current year

If the retirement posting exists, the data entry view for that particular document will open as shown below:

Notify the requester on request completion

To inform the requester about the successful asset retirement transaction, send to the requester a confirmation on the successful asset retirement. A sample email confirmation is shown below:

Proceed to the step 8.3.3.10.10: 4.7.10 Receive confirmation that asset has been retired.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Retire partial or entire asset from Fixed Assets Register
steps.detail:
The process for fixed asset retirement begins when there is a need to decommission / sell / transfer / retire a fixed asset. The Business sends a request via email for asset retirement and relevant supporting documents required to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office. The request should include the following information:

Company code

Fixed Asset Number

Type of Retirement

Asset Retirement Effective Date

Cost Centre as maintained in SAP

Sample email request for asset retirement:

GFS Back Office R2R Team will process the asset retirement in SAP by using T-code ABAVN for Scrapping and F-92 for Non-invoice retirements with Sales Proceeds.

Please ensure that you perform control CPX008 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.

In case of the asset retirement by:

Perform asset retirement by scrapping

To display the document details access T-code FB03.

The document will be shown as below:

Proceed to sub step C) Notify the requester on request completion

Perform asset retirement with sales proceeds

“Posting Date” - input the current date

The posting key for debiting GL Account is “40”. Hence in the “Next Line Item” section, enter the following:

“Account” - input the GL Account. The GL number should be provided by the requester in the NewGen workitem. Alternatively, access the appropriate number through the Single Chart of Account (SCOA) by following this link. Note: Please only use Internet Explorer for accessing the link.

There are instances where the sales proceeds from the asset retirements are not paid by a customer, but instead deducted from the employee(s) salary and wages account, or vendor account:

As such, it is then the employee’s responsibility to bear the cost of the unusable asset. Message of Successful creation of Work Queue will pop up. Make a note of the Worklist Number:

Enter T-code “AR31” in SAP.

Press Enter and fill in the details as mentioned below and press execute  button:

steps.title: Retire entire asset for an invoice sale

GFS Back Office R2R will be notified once the sale of asset has been completed and will then account for the profit & loss on the disposal of the asset. If the proceeds from the sale relate to more than one asset, the proceeds will be distributed across each of the individual assets in the sale. If the disposed asset does not exist in the asset register, the asset cannot be retired. The entire asset will now be retired from FA register. The purchase and sale of fixed assets is executed at fair market valuation.

Post document

Once all project related transactions are raised, validated and posted, GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets) proceeds with the monthly settlement clearing for capital project WBSE to transfer charges against WBSE to the AUC accounts. This occurs via a settlement rule created against the WBSE in the project structure. This is an important control point as costs on all capital projects are zeroed at month-end.

steps.title: Monitor and collect project transactions
steps.detail:
Business has the responsibility to monitor and collect project transactions such as goods / service receipt, salary expenses, material movements, time expenses and T&E expenses.

The following types of transactions can be posted to the project:

Goods / services procured: Please proceed to the process 4.3.3.4 Perform Indirect Materials Purchase (i-Buy) and then to 4.3.3.6 Perform goods or service receipt

Salary expenses: Please proceed to the process 8.3.2.10 Post payroll

Material movements: Please proceed to step 4.7.2: 8.4.2.2.2 Post material movements

Time expenses: Please proceed to step 4.7.3: 8.4.2.2.3 Post time expenses

T&E expenses: Please proceed to step 4.7.4: 8.4.2.2.4 Post T&E expenses

Clinical trial accruals: Please proceed to the process 8.6.1.23 Prepare and post clinical trial accruals

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Post material movements
steps.detail:
Direct materials used for project related activities must be monitored and recorded to the specific project. For example, for R&D projects, materials could be issued as part of R&D work.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Post time expenses
steps.detail:
Time expenses related to the execution of project are recorded in Cross Application Time Sheet (CATS) in UK and Sweden only and through normal payroll in other regions.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Post T&E expenses
steps.detail:
T&E expenses linked to projects must be recorded to underlying project.

(Note: T&E expenses come via concur and can be posted as long as the postings come with the WBSE code)

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Review expenses posted to the project
steps.detail:
Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office reviews and validates the expenses for completeness, accuracy and propriety, if applicable, to ensure all project expenditures are captured:

Salary expenses related to the execution of project

Time expenses recorded

Material costs and quantity

T&E report is validated and analysed to determine completeness, accuracy and propriety of expenses

After the review and validation, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office sends review request to the project managers. The Project Manager reviews to ensure that all expenses posted to the project are valid. Costs that are not directly associated with the project should not be posted to the project code. For capital projects, all expenses will be capitalised monthly and whenever the asset is ready to be brought into service.

Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office must determine if adjustments will be required in the recorded project related transactions.

Please ensure to perform control CPX004 as per the FCAS framework for the respective unit.

Review expenses posted to the project

Pre-month end closing activities may identify project related costs that are incorrectly posted to site costs. This should be picked up during site cost review performed in Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office and is later queried with the local site finance team or capital projects team. Sample query:

Sample query is shown below (PO 4800059428):

Sample query is shown below (PO 4800059823):

Embedded finance and the Project Manager review these queries and confirm back to GFS Middle Office, if any adjustment is required.

Representative Offices

Representative offices located in MEA and Europe will need to follow below steps to record Fixed Asset posting in UK or Sweden Hubs book.

Request a capital project via CAS, please proceed to 8.4.1.3 Review and approve capital projects for details.

Upon invoice on purchase of Fixed Asset posted, a journal entry will need to be passed in Hubs book. Please proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.2.2.6 Prepare manual adjustments.

For Sweden, journal entry will need to be posted with GL 99100010 with WBSE and subsequently settle into AUC via 99101090 (For UK - Accounts are 70770150 and 70770160 respectively)

Subsequent to settlement, Middle Office Finance will need to send in Notice of Project Closure Template (NPC) to capitalise the Fixed Asset in UK or Sweden Hubs book. Please proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.2.4 Close and capitalise projects for details.

Possible outcomes:

In case adjustment is required, then proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.2.2.6 Prepare manual adjustments

In case adjustment is not required, and

WBSE is not statistical, then proceed to Step 4.7.7: 8.4.2.2.7 Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC)

WBSE is statistical, then go proceed Step 4.7.8: 8.4.2.2.8 Prepare month-end reports

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Prepare manual adjustments
steps.detail:
If adjustment is required, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office prepare the related manual journal templates for processing and raise them in their workflow tool.

Prepare manual adjustments

The adjustment for costs can be various. Among the examples (list is not exhaustive) are:

Accruing capital costs

Adjusting from site costs to AUC cost line

Reclassifying costs from one project to another

Recharging payroll costs to the project where individuals are part / full-time on a project

Please proceed to 8.3.2.2 Process Manual Journal Entries for further details on how the journal entry is submitted, approved and posted.

Once the adjustment review is complete, please proceed to step 4.7.7:8.4.2.2.7 Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC) for a non-statistical WBSE. For a statistical WBSE, please proceed to step 4.7.8:8.4.2.2.8 Prepare month-end reports.

Task #

TASK NAME

steps.title: Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC)
steps.detail:
Note: This step is not applicable to Brazil as it will continue to follow the current process until the configuration activities are completed by SAP IT team.

Once all project related transactions are raised, validated and posted, GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets) proceeds with the monthly settlement clearing for capital project WBSE to transfer charges against WBSE to the AUC accounts. This occurs via a settlement rule created against the WBSE in the project structure. This is an important control point as costs on all capital projects are zeroed at month-end.

Prior to the fixed asset module closing at each month end, run T-code CJ88 (Individual WBS Settlement) / CJ8G (Mass month end WBS settlement) to settle (transfer) WBSE element costs into the corresponding AUC.

Please note that for NAM, due to large WBSE transaction volumes to AUC, a settlement background job is scheduled on daily basis at 23:00 US time with additional manual settlement during month-end.

Please find below process steps to run CJ88 for individual WBS settlement and CJ8G for mass month-end settlement.

Individual WBS settlement

Log in to SAP system.

A.1) Test run monthly settlement

To run settlement of actual WBSE costs enter T-code CJ88 and press Enter.

Key in WBS Element Number and execute in the present period.

Execute  as Test Run to check for any error.

The Settlement screen will appear as below.

Click on detail list icon on the left corner to see the settled cost for AUC and asset number.

Ensure processing is complete without any errors and there is settlement executed, which reflects in the above screenshot as highlighted.

After clicking on the detail list, the screen will appear as below:

In case the processing remains incomplete due to errors, a screen like below will appear. Double click on the error message to display the error messages.

Below is an indicative list of errors commonly observed in CJ88 (list is not exhaustive) and the actions to be taken to resolve them:

Error Type

Reason

Action

Yellow

There are remaining balances in AUC

No action is needed. This error will reflect in partial completion of Capitalisation. It can be processed as usual.

Red

The settlement amount exceeds the AUC Balances

Check the AUC amount in CJI3 with the capitalisation amount. If there is a variance, check the errors and rectify the same.

Re-run the processing until all errors are resolved and processing is successful.

A.2) Run actual monthly settlement

After ensuring the settlement runs correctly without errors, go back to the previous page (Press F3). This time untick Test Run and proceed to Execute .

1. PURPOSE
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) sets out the mandatory activities for the capital project
approval process.
Capital Projects are reviewed and approved through the CAS system. As an output of the process,
if a capital project is approved, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office team will submit a request
to GFS Back Office DMT to create a project account code. In other cases, the project could be
deferred until following year or terminated if it is no longer required.

steps.title: Draft / Amend proposal forms (Pre-Investment Proposal / Engineering Proposal)
steps.detail:
The Business completes / amends the proposal forms for their capital project. There is Excel

based standardised forms for investment and engineering proposals.

steps.title: Complete Business Case. Explain benefits, costs, savings, external vendors, terms, length of contract, etc. and check budget available
steps.detail:
After completing the project proposal forms, Business completes a more detailed analysis for

each capital project in Excel. This may include:

Cost benefit analysis

Possible future savings as a result of carrying out the project

Length and terms of any contract, and

External vendors who may be involved

In case the project value is above the threshold requiring approval from the Capital Approval

Board (CAB), as per the Capital and Fixed Asset Standard (refer Section 7 References for link),

email the business cases to the CAB representative Susan Booth,

Susan.Booth@astrazeneca.com for annual budget review and approval which happens at year-

end. In this case, proceed to Step 4.7.3: 8.4.1.3.3 Review Capital project proposal.

cas

If the project value is below the threshold, then proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.1.3.6 Create / Amend

new capital project record.

steps.title: Review Capital project proposal
steps.detail:
The CAB collects all the capital project proposals and business cases. Based on the information

received, the CAB will decide on the overall budget for the year.

Possible outcomes:

If the application is rejected for consideration in a future year, proceed to Step 4.7.4:

8.4.1.3.4 Request deferred until next year.

If any adjustments are required, proceed to Step 4.7.5: 8.4.1.3.5 Amend capital

project proposal.

If the rejection is permanent, then the process ends.

If the application is approved, proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.1.3.6 Create / amend new

capital project record.

steps.title: Request deferred until next year
steps.detail:
Capital projects may be rejected for a variety of reasons. The projects could be deferred until the

following year for reconsideration by the CAB. Revise and amend, if necessary, and submit the

proposal and project documentation in the next cycle.

Proceed to Step 4.7.1: 8.4.1.3.1 Draft / amend proposal forms (Pre-Investment Proposal /

Engineering Proposal).

steps.title: Amend capital project proposal
steps.detail:
Where any adjustments and / or amendments are required to secure approval (e.g. the level of

spend allowed, the project timeline, further market research), the Business is required to amend

the original proposal and business case in line with the recommendations provided by the CAB

prior to reconsideration. Proceed to Step 4.7.1: 8.4.1.3.1 Draft / amend proposal forms (Pre-

Investment Proposal / Engineering Proposal).

steps.title: Create/amend new capital project record
steps.detail:
Once approvals have been granted, Business will create a new capital project record within CAS

for DOA approval.

Delegation of Authority review

Based on the DOA built within CAS, notifications will be sent automatically to approvers within

the Business for review and approval as per Delegations Standard Limits from Global DOA

framework. Business leads provide the first level of approval.

Possible outcomes of DOA approval:

If rework is required, proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.1.3.6 Create / amend new capital

project record.

If project is declined, proceed to Step 4.7.7: 8.4.1.3.7 Automated notification for

project declined.

If application is approved, proceed to Steps 4.7.8, 4.7.11 and 4.7.12: 8.4.1.3.8

Automated notification for project approval, 8.4.1.3.11 Automated notification for

project approval, for action and 8.4.1.3.12 Automated notification of project

approval respectively.

steps.detail:

A) Complete the E Code WBSE Maintenance Form

Complete the E Code WBSE Maintenance Form based on the information from CAS request. All

fields marked with an asterisk (*) and in red colour are mandatory to complete. For E Code

WBSE Maintenance Form, refer to Section 9 Appendices

A.1) Update tab “Project Maintenance Form”

Populate the fields in “Project Maintenance Form” tab in the E Code WBSE Maintenance Form

using below guidance:

Maintenance Type - “New”

Region - “APAC/MEA/INDIA”

Country - Select the Country of the entity

Company code - Input the company code

Requestor’s email - Mention email address of the requestor

Reason for maintenance request - Note containing the general narrative “To create

WBSE for the project” and the project description (for example, “To create WBS for the

project “Introduce 4 incubators for QC and SHIDC”)

Project coding mask - E. XXXXXX. XX. XX. XX. XX. XX

Project Category - will always be “AZ Capital Project- E”

Object Class - “Investment” (No Input required from user, please ignore these fields)

Planning Level - “1” (No Input required from user, please ignore these fields)

Planning Element - “Yes” (No Input required from user, please ignore these fields)

CAS Request Number - Please input 6 digits of the CAS request number (i.e. 123456 for

R-123456). If CAS request Number is having “0” as beginning digit, please input sign

before “0”. (i.e. R-012345, please input ‘012345)

ISO Country Code - Will populate as per selected country

Project Definition - will populate as per CAS request number

Controlling Area - will populate as per country selected

Project Type - Either select “E2 - IT capital” for IT projects and “E1 - Engineering Capital”

or “E3- Revenue Settlement” in other cases

Project Description - Title of the project

Investments (< 1M USD)/Middle-Sized Capital Investments (1M-5M USD)/Major-Scaled

Reason for Investment - “S0-Miscellaneous”, “S1-Risk Compliance”, “S2-Risk

Replacement”, “S3- Value”, “S4-Capacity”, “S5-Strategic”, “S6-Central”

Applicant Number - Provide the details as per the CAS request

Business Area - Input the “Business Area” of the cost center from the CAS request

Profit Center - Input the “Profit center”

Responsible Cost Center - “Cost Center” from CAS request

Requesting Cost Center - “Cost Center” from CAS request

Start Date - Date of receiving the CAS request

CAS request

Long Text - optional field (would be specified in the request)

Budget - Input budget into year 1 and the total must tie to CAS budget. You can also split

the budget over a few years if required but the total must still tie to CAS Budget

Appendices [30](#appendices)](#appendices) # # PURPOSE This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) sets out the mandatory activities for tracking Physical Fixed Assets. Briefly, Physical Fixed Assets require regular tracking to ensure that the assets recorded in the system are consistent with the physical assets on site. This process covers the tracking of fixed assets, including performing physical inventory checks. The process is linked with processing retirements and impairments. For example, following completion of asset verification, Business will determine if there are asset retirements and impairments that must be performed. # AUDIENCE This SOP applies to Business, Embedded Finance, GFS Back Office R2R, GFS Middle Office and GFS Back Office DMT. Note: For NAM, LATAM, MEA and India, Sweden and UK Hubs, activities indicated for GFS Back Office DMT are currently performed by GFS Back Office R2R, until the transition to GFS Back Office DMT is completed (estimated Q2 2020). - This transition is a GFS led transition jointly done by AZ and Genpact managed by [**Lukasz**](mailto:lukasz.lobocki@astrazeneca.com) **Lobocki (Luke)** centrally, with support from **Amit Matta** (Back Office) at Genpact - The Documentation Team will be performing the updates on receipt of information # SCOPE The table indicates the scope of the Systems, Regions, Countries and Business Areas that this document relates to. Anything not explicitly included is excluded: | | | |----|----| | Business Process | Description | | Global | This process is applicable to all AZ entities except for those entities that have an approved exception by GPO R2R | # PROCEDURE ## Process Map ## Assumptions and Pre-requisites The table below contains a summary of the assumptions and pre-requisites required for the process this operating procedure relates to:
Assumption / Pre-requisite Description
As per AZ Global Standard, all entities need to perform a physical verification of all assets with an NBV above a locally defined threshold at least once every three years.

Below are the entities in scope for GFS Back Office R2R Team to initiate the activity on physical verification of Fixed Assets:

  1. UK Hubs – 0010 and UK40

  2. Sweden Hubs – SE10

  3. NAM - 4314, 5351, 5353, 5355, 8311, 7301

For remaining entities in Europe, as well as entities in NAM, LATAM, MEA and India, this activity will be initiated in GFS Back Office R2R starting in September 2020.
Intangible assets are not in scope of this SOP Intangible assets including goodwill, IS intangibles and project intangibles are not within the scope of this SOP.
## Frequency The control for fixed asset verification should be performed annually and all fixed assets (as per the Capital and Fixed Asset Standard) should be verified once in three years. ## Systems and Access The table below contains a summary of the system(s) and accesses required for the process this operating procedure relates to:
